design: Outcome-free comparability of each target campus with its eight peers (size, record density, preventive share, empty reactive record, labour recorded, building-system mix, feature shift), related to the held-out check and the forward test of the peer-trained ranking; a labour-recording audit by campus and building system; and the record flow from the raw file to the analytical panel.

definitions.unit: one building system of one building in one quarter (a panel row)

windows.heldout: all units of the target against all peer units
windows.forward: units of the target anchored in 2017 to 2019 against peer units anchored in 2016 or earlier

definitions.feature_shift: gradient-boosted classifier (XGBoost, CPU, 200 trees of depth 4, learning rate 0.1), target units against an equal number of peer units (each class at most 50000), 5 folds stratified by class and grouped by building; AUC pooled over the out-of-fold scores, with its range over folds; per building system from the same out-of-fold scores when each class has at least 30 units; size-matched: every campus subsampled to the smallest campus's unit count, median of 5 draws
definitions.omitted_features: the two reactive-premium features, constants of the building system computed on the training campuses
definitions.empty_react4_share: share of units with no reactive work order in the four quarters up to and including the anchor quarter
definitions.labor_pos_share: share of the unit's work orders (both categories) with positive labour hours
definitions.deviation: |log(target / peers)| for record densities and the system share; |target - peers| for shares
definitions.system_mix_tvd: total-variation distance between the distributions of units over building systems
definitions.heldout_outcome: top-decile lift of f^(-c) on the units of c (campus) or of s on c (pair), over the whole window; a pair is evaluable with at least 10 high-burden units and 100 units; it reaches two-fold when the lift is at least 2
definitions.forward_outcome: top-decile lift in 2017 to 2019 of f_h^(-c), trained on the other campuses' units anchored in 2016 or earlier; same evaluability
definitions.lift_ceiling: largest attainable top-decile lift, min(high-burden units, m) / m divided by the base rate, with m the size of the top decile; it is below 10 when the base rate exceeds 0.10
definitions.supported: evidence score of at least 2/3: the verdict of the held-out map (heldout) or the peer verdict formed from pre-2017 records (forward)
definitions.campus_rank_correlation: Spearman coefficient over the nine campuses; exact two-sided p-value from all 9! orderings
definitions.pair_association: Spearman coefficient over the evaluable pairs and the AUC of the diagnostic for the pairs short of two-fold (the probability that a short pair has the larger value, so below 0.5 means short pairs have smaller values), each with two-sided p-values from 10000 permutations of the outcome within building system and within campus; for campus-level diagnostics, the exact campus-block p-value from all orderings of the diagnostic over the campuses replaces the within-campus one, because the within-system permutation treats the pairs of one campus as independent
definitions.pairs_in_check: held-out check: the 95 evaluable pairs with a verdict (two further evaluable pairs, 11-F20 and 5-G30, have no verdict and are left out); forward test: the 91 evaluable pairs of the stored table
definitions.sampling_check: for an evaluable pair, the binomial probability of at most the observed number of high-burden units in the top decile if the true lift were 2, and the one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound of the lift; units are treated as independent, so both understate the uncertainty of clustered records
definitions.labour_extreme: reactive work order above the system's 99th percentile of positive hours over the nine campuses
definitions.base_rate_panel_thresholds: high-burden share with the system-specific 75th percentile fitted on the whole panel (the Table 1 definition)
definitions.base_rate_peer_thresholds: high-burden share with the threshold fitted on the other eight campuses (the labels of the held-out check)

steps.description: work orders in the raw file, 12 universities
records of the 3 universities without building identifiers (8, 9, 12) removed
records without a building identifier removed (nine campuses)
records without a building-system code removed
records without a parseable start date removed
records with no maintenance category removed; the reconstructed work-order stream
work orders dated in the last active quarter of their building removed: that quarter has no next quarter on record, so its units carry no outcome and leave the panel

labour_hours_in_panel_work_orders.note: work orders without labour hours are not excluded: their hours count as zero in the unit's labour sum, and negative entries are summed as recorded
